notes.title: New Reigns Game has launched on Steam
notes.content:
[h1]Reigns: Three Kingdoms has launched on Steam![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2437040/Reigns_Three_Kingdoms/

Jump back in time to ancient China. You arrive during the end years of the Han Dynasty, inspired by the tales of [i]The Romance of the Three Kingdoms[/i], you will come across a wide cast of notable characters; will you form alliances or rivalries? Journey through epic quests across the 13 regions and make choices that will ripple throughout your adventures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25720766/5595906b9ca4bb02430a06f7f58e0da5593191cd.gif[/img]
[h3]Newest Feature: Card Battles[/h3]
A brand new twist to the Reignsverse; a card-swiping turn-based battle system. Throughout your journey, you'll come across opportunities to battle opponents using a draft of the characters you [strike][i]collect[/i][/strike] recruit on the way. This fresh spin allows you to use the classic swiping mechanic to execute your attacks, so you must plan your strategy to be victorious!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25720766/c0503c577a804224455d2266dd59ec38f9a99767.gif[/img]
[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
Along with the combat, we have added multiplayer to the series; battle your friends or strangers online and work your way up the leaderboard. This feature is also crossplay; you can battle against players on Switch and Mobile

[h3]Complete the set[/h3]
Whether you have one or all of the Reigns titles, we have collected all the ones on Steam into one epic bundle, allowing you to complete your Reigns series and save some money

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37837/Reigns_Complete_Set/

notes.title: New Reigns Game is coming to Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Reigns: Three Kingdoms is coming to Steam on January 11th![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2437040/Reigns_Three_Kingdoms/

The latest addition to the Reignsverse is the most tantalising one yet. Inspired by the beloved epic, [i]The Romance of the Three Kingdoms[/i], you'll take on the challenges found in the heart of the Han Dynasty. It’ll be up to you to unite the 13 regions and forge a path through decisive decision-making.

With unique characters, storylines, and quests to discover; this retelling of the stories found in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms will immerse you in diplomacy and military tactics with legendary characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772779/f2b93dcd8065ac86b3f17f89eb199c7cc3df2c5b.gif[/img]

The newest feature of the series is the card battle system. These battles incorporate the unique card-swiping mechanic, used throughout the Reignsverse, creating a new and effective way to add a fresh spin to the series. The characters you encounter will join your party and can be included in your drafts for each battle, you will also be able to challenge friends online!

[previewyoutube=jpYqrQoQm-M;full][/previewyoutube]

Eager to play already? You can still play the mobile version on Netflix!

notes.title: New Reigns Game is available NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]Reigns: Three Kingdoms is available NOW! [/h2]

[url=https://www.netflix.com/game/81569952][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25720766/f2b93dcd8065ac86b3f17f89eb199c7cc3df2c5b.gif[/img][/url]

This new instalment in the Reigns series is undoubtedly our most ambitious one yet. Based on the beloved epic, [i]The Romance of the Three Kingdoms[/i], you'll take on the challenge of uniting 13 regions of the Han Dynasty, one decision at a time. 

Each region contains unique characters, storylines and quests where you'll use diplomacy, courtship and military strength to become its leader. Each of these plots are adapted from the web of stories found in [i]The Romance of the Three Kingdoms[/i] which means you'll meet many legendary characters along the way. 

Those characters will join your party in the card battle system. It was a challenge to build engaging battles with only two inputs, left and right, but we believe we have done it. You can even draft your deck to challenge friends online or test your wits to climb the ranked leaderboard. 

Reigns: Three Kingdoms is [url=https://www.netflix.com/game/81569952]AVAILABLE NOW[/url] on Android and iOS exclusively for Netflix subscribers. 

[previewyoutube=RszwKQNIyD4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Reigns update adds 100 cards, including fake elephant
notes.content: “Game Of Thrones + Tinder = You Died,” Alec declared when he told us Wot He Thought of left-right-swiping monarch simulator Reigns [official site]. He enjoyed it, y’see, though I don’t know whether he engaged in intercourse with his PC or… I don’t know how this all works. Whatever he does, he (and you) can now do more of it, as a free update has added over 100 new cards, including new deaths and not an elephant. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Content Update: 100 new cards!
notes.content:
This free update adds more than 100 new cards including: 
- 1 new character
- 3 new deaths
- 5 new objectives
- 1 fake elephant
The main plot should be slightly easier to solve now. The game should be slightly less repetitive. If you want to reset the game, press R for 5 seconds. Thank you for the amazing welcome you gave Reigns!

notes.title: Update 1.22
notes.content:
This update should solve the corrupt data bug. If that happened to you, try pressing "r" for 5 sec to reset the game. If it doesnt work, try to locate the local game files and delete them (generally in C:\Users\<user_name>\AppData\LocalLow\devolver\reigns or Users/username/library/cache/devolver/reigns on Mac ). The bug happened when the game was not closing properly, creating faulty game save and unfortunately, I can't retrieve them. Try to press "esc" and use the "quit" button to save your progress. 

If you still have the problem, it may be because the game can't write in the local game file (the dir described up there).

This update is also an attempt at solving some of the crashes encountered at start. Still looking into some of these. Feel free to ask for refund if it doesn't work for you. 

And also, a great big thanks for your support and your interest in the game. We want to do more Reigns! http://nerial.co.uk/reigns/#more
